dj.dated: Finance laws 2017-2025 (Loi n°203/AN/25 for 2025); the CGI itself not held

vat.name: Taxe sur la valeur ajoutée
vat.statute: TVA 10 % as imposed by the finance laws (LF 2025 art. on electric vehicles; Loi n°111/AN/20 art. 28; Loi n°142/AN/21); the CGI rate article not held
vat.doc: LF 2025: "Il est perçu au profit du budget de l'État, une taxe intérieure de consommation de 10% et une taxe sur la valeur ajoutée de 10% sur les véhicules électriques importés ou produits sur le territoire national"; Loi n°111/AN/20 art. 28: "une taxe intérieure de consommation (TIC) de 10% et une taxe sur la valeur ajoutée de 10% sur les couches et lange pour bébés"; Loi n°142/AN/21: "en plus de la taxe intérieure de consommation de 23% une taxe sur la valeur ajoutée de 10%". The general rate article of the CGI is not held: grade B (rate from the finance laws' own charging lines).
notes: VAT 10 % taken from the finance laws' charging lines (the CGI rate article not held)
unsupported: CGI rate article and exemptions not held

bi.dated: Loi n°1/14 du 24 décembre 2020 (impôts sur les revenus) with the LF 2025/2026 derogations; LF 2021-2025 not held

cit.name: Impôt sur les revenus des sociétés
cit.doc: art. 103: "Le montant des revenus imposables est arrondi en millier de francs burundais le plus proche et imposé au taux de trente pour cent (30%), à l'exception des revenus locatifs imposables au taux prévu à l'article 21" (OCR prints "(50%)" after the words "trente pour cent": the words govern). The 2020 law is the latest IR text held; the LF 2025/2026 derogations read do not change the rate: grade B.
notes: Loi IR 2020 art. 103: 30 %; rounding to the nearest 1 000 FBu not applied
unsupported: minimum tax: only the individuals' art. 21 minimum located

wht.name: Retenue à la source (art. 122)
wht.statute: Loi n°1/14 du 24/12/2020 art. 122 (15 %); art. 102 (final for non-residents)
wht.doc: art. 122: "Une retenue de quinze pour cent (15%) est pratiquée sur les paiements ci-après effectués par les personnes résidentes ... 1° les dividendes ... 2° les paiements d'intérêts de toute nature ... 3° les redevances à l'exception de celles payées à l'État ; 4° les rémunérations de prestations fournies par des personnes non-résidentes au Burundi"; art. 102: for non-residents without a permanent establishment the withholdings "ont un caractère libératoire".

ss.dated: Financial Act 2024/2025 (FY July 2024 - June 2025); the 2025/26 Act not held

cit.name: Business Profit Tax
cit.statute: Financial Act 2024/2025 s. 8 (2) and Schedule 1 (3) replacing Taxation Act 2009 Schedule 1 (30 %)
cit.doc: s. 8 (2): "For that tax year the rates are per the Taxation Act, 2009 (amended 201[6]), the business profit tax is set equally for Small Business Enterprise, Medium Business Enterprise and Large Business Enterprise at flat rate of 30%." Schedule: "Business Profit Tax is a flat rated tax imposed on net profit of all business organizations 30%". The Act covers FY 2024/25 (to June 2025); FY 2025/26 not held: grade B.
notes: Financial Act 2024/2025: BPT 30 % for FY 2024/25 (the 2025/26 Act not held)

wht.name: Withholding tax (Schedule 1 (2))
wht.statute: Financial Act 2024/2025 Schedule 1 (2) 'Other Withholding Tax Rates' (dividends, interest, royalties 10 %; technical/consultancy fees 20 %)
wht.doc: Schedule 1 (2): "Dividends 10% 10% / Interest 10% 10% / Royalties 10% 10% / Rent 20% 20% / ... Technical/consultancy fees 20% 20%" (the FY 2023/24 and FY 2024/25 columns agree). Rates apply to payments generally (no separate non-resident schedule).

ss.vat_why: sales tax: the Financial Act 2024/2025 chapter 7 says 20 % 'as per Taxation Act 2009 (amended 2016)' while its replacement Schedule 1 (2) lists 18 %: conflicting wordings, FY 2025/26 Act not held

zw.dated: Finance Act 2025 (No. 7 of 2025) s. 34 (quotes the 2025 wording of the VAT general rate); Finance Acts 2023, 2024, 2024 (No. 2)

vat.name: Value Added Tax
vat.statute: Finance Act [Chapter 23:04] Chapter IV Schedule Part I ('fifteen per centum'), as shown by Finance Act 2025 s. 34 (15,5 % only from 1 Jan 2026)
vat.doc: Finance Act 2025 s. 34: "With effect from the 1st January, 2026, the Schedule to Chapter IV of the Finance Act [Chapter 23:04] is amended in Part I ('General Rate of Value Added Tax') by the deletion of 'fifteen per centum' and the substitution of 'fifteen comma five per centum'." So the general rate in force throughout 2025 was 15 %. The Schedule itself was not read (grade B); zero-rated and exempt supplies not applied.
notes: VAT 15 % in 2025 (Finance Act 2025 s. 34 raises it to 15,5 % from 1 Jan 2026); zero-rated basic foods not separable
unsupported: zero-rated and exempt supplies (VAT Act Schedules) not applied
